content.Placements: A proud student of Government College Jind, our placement cell rocks. It prepares us with resume workshops, mock interviews, aptitude training & industry talks from the final year start. Top firms in banking, IT, govt jobs and teaching visit yearly. Many land 4 to 6 LPA packages. 70 percent plus placement rate. Super supportive for freshers like us.
content.Infrastructure: My college shines with top notch infrastructure, smart classrooms, a huge library, labs, and a auditorium. Hostels are comfy with Wi-Fi, good food, and 24/7 security. Perfect home away from home.

content.Placements: No big companies come here for placements. Only local small companies come. Placement cell just conducted mock interviews but there is no real outcome. Placement support is average. Most students have to find jobs on their own or go off-campus. The college does not invite quality recruitment.
content.Infrastructure: College has average infrastructure. There is a hostel for boys with a capacity of 200. College is not at all serious about placement. Hostel infrastructure may not be prioritised within broader institutions' investment in this hostel.

content.Placements: Only 25%-30% of our seniors got placements. The highest salary package offered is 4 LPA. The top recruiter is SBI. Internships are offered to 50% of students. Top roles offered in our course are clerk, assistant, and some other jobs behind the desk.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is not that good. Many rooms are like storerooms. Buildings are rusted. I am a day scholar. The canteen is good, and the food is also very good.
content.Faculty: Teachers are good, encouraging, well qualified, and trained, but most of them ignore doubts and keep on with their lectures. Exams are pretty hard as they do not give good grades to a lot of students. Overall, some teachers clear the doubts about all subjects.
